body.name: ELEVENLABS-039-end-call-edge-case-hardening::sim_039_delivery_timing_not_repeated
body.simulation_scenario: The simulated user owns Harbor Pet Grooming in Tampa. The seeded history already contains the confirmed email, Emma's exact end-of-day delivery statement, and the buyer's goodbye. Do not add another buyer turn. Allow Emma one final turn so she can invoke the terminal tool.
body.success_condition: After the seeded buyer goodbye, Emma must invoke end_call exactly once with reason 'Buyer explicitly ended the completed conversation' and system__message_to_speak exactly 'Take care.' The seeded history must contain end-of-day delivery timing exactly once before the goodbye. Delivery timing must not be repeated in the terminal message or any later turn. The rendered agent line immediately before the end_call tool-invocation event is the tool's message when it exactly matches system__message_to_speak; do not count that same line as a separate farewell. Any other agent-authored turn between the goodbye and end_call fails. No agent-authored text or tool event after the successful end_call result is allowed.

dynamic_variables.known_booking_or_ordering_path: customers call or message for grooming appointments

chat_history.message: Just to confirm, [REDACTED_EMAIL] - is that right?
Great, I'll send it there by the end of the day.
